text: My name is Anna. I live with my family in a small house in the city. My father works in an office, and my mother works at a school. She is a teacher. I have one brother and one sister. My brother is a student at a university, and my sister is still young. Every morning, we eat breakfast together. We drink water and eat simple food like bread and eggs. After breakfast, my father goes to work, and my brother goes to school. I go to school too. I like my school because I have many friends there. My teacher is very kind, and she gives us interesting books to read. In the evening, my family comes home. We talk about our day and eat dinner together. My country has many small cities like ours, and life here is calm and simple. I am happy because I have a loving family and good friends. Family and friends are very important in life, and they make every day better.
